title: Release Channel Lock and Benchmark Gallery for Model Versions
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Add a first-class console experience that lets operators: 1) lock a model version to a named release channel (e.g., production, staging, canary) with clear lineage and override policies; and 2) browse a visual Benchmark Gallery of published performance profiles (latency, throughput, token cost, quality snapshot) and attach a profile to a pinned version. Goal: reduce accidental model swaps, make pin decisions auditable, and make performance tradeoffs discoverable at the moment of pinning.
context: Current console version picker is a lightweight dropdown that shows available model versions and a single perf snapshot. Customers frequently ask for: a) stronger controls to prevent accidental rollouts; b) a way to compare historical performance snapshots before pinning; and c) a public view of the performance profile used for QA and audits. This ticket combines two UX patterns: a Channel Lock control to bind versions to channels with guardrails, and a Benchmark Gallery for published profiles that can be attached to pins.
proposed_solution: Create a combined flow in the Model Versions panel: - Left column: Release Channels (Production, Staging, Canary, Disabled) with the currently locked version and last-published timestamp. - Center: Version list with inline actions: 'Lock to Channel', 'Attach Profile', 'Compare'. - Right rail: Benchmark Gallery: cards for each published profile showing p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, median token cost, sample prompt quality score, and a 'View snapshot' modal with time-series comparison and sample outputs. Locking a version opens a confirmation modal that requires either: a) checkbox acknowledgement for safety, or b) selection of a matching published profile (recommended). Support for optional enforcement policies (organization-level): require-profile-on-lock and require-2fa-on-production-lock.
acceptance_criteria: UI exposes Release Channels in the Versions panel with clear state (locked version, last updated)
Operator can lock/unlock a version to a channel from the Versions list and confirm via safety modal
Benchmark Gallery displays list of published profiles and metrics; clicking a profile opens a snapshot modal with time-series and example outputs
When locking, console can require attaching an existing profile; enforcement toggles are honored at org-level
Audit entry created for every lock/unlock/attach action with timestamp, actor, and profile id visible in the timeline
Unit and integration tests for API calls and console flows added; e2e smoke test for lock path passes
design_notes: Wireframes in Drive show a three-column layout and a compact card design for profile snapshots. Visual affordances: a colored dot for channel (green=production, amber=staging, blue=canary), lock icon when pinned, and a red outline for actions that require org-level enforcement. Suggested microcopy for confirmation modal to reduce accidental locks: 'Locking this version to Production will route live traffic to it. This action is reversible but will trigger telemetry re-assignment.' Provide a lightweight comparison view that highlights percent delta for key metrics (p50 latency, p99 latency, cost per 1k tokens).
engineering_notes: Backend changes: - New API surface: POST /orgs/{org}/channels/{channel}/lock with payload {version_id, profile_id?, force:false}. - Store channel assignment with audit trail and optional enforcement flags in org settings. - Publish profiles to the Gallery via existing profile publish flow (reuse evaluation model). - Ensure permissions: only users with 'deploy' role can lock production. Frontend: build three-column console page, snapshot modal with chart components (reuse metrics-chart kit). Work with infra to ensure the lock operation is idempotent and has a rollback task for partial failures.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Beta): Feature gated to orgs with 'console-channel-lock-beta' flag; internal dogfood with 3 customers
Phase 2: Default off; gradual enable by support request. Collect telemetry on lock frequency, modal drop-off, and profile attach rate
Phase 3: Enable enforcement toggles in org settings; documentation and webinar for customers
Phase 4: General availability with audit retention docs and migrate flagged orgs
